commercial_building_character: Largely residential suburb; home to Knox Private Hospital (medical) and Westfield Knox shopping centre (major retail centre) — Wikipedia gives no explicit industrial-estate description.
source_quotes: Wantirna is a suburb in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, 24 km (15 mi) east of Melbourne's Central Business District, located within the City of Knox local government area. Wantirna recorded a population of 14,237 at the 2021 census.
Knox Private Hospital and Westfield Knox shopping centre are located in Wantirna.
